paper:2026-b6530448cc.abstract: A comprehensive survey providing a macro-level taxonomy and systematic overview of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D GS) for explicit radiance field representation and real-time rendering. The authors analyze core mathematical principles, differentiable tile-based rasterization, and density control mechanisms, alongside extensions addressing sparse inputs, compression, and anti-aliasing. It benchmarks leading 3D GS frameworks across SLAM, dynamic scene modeling, and human avatars while identifying future directions in physics-informed and generalizable 3D world models.
